# M0-a-08 — closing check of hardening round S4 (lane `check/M0-a-08-close-s4`, flow flow-7, stage group S, 2026-10-18)

Lane `check/M0-a-08-close-s4` ran under Opus 5.5 in Claude Code in the session's cloud container (Linux x64, Intel
Xeon, 4 cpu, 16 GiB, Node v24.12.0). It started on 2026-10-14 (lane-log lines 10:01 – 11:04). That container was
relaunched before the check finished, and nothing the seat had made then survived. Its mirror and its mutant scripts
Z01 – Z21 were gone. The seat therefore continued under the CONTINUE RULE on 2026-10-18 from 16:44 and re-ran every
part. The machine check printed `linux:Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz:4cpu:16gib`, which matches the brief.

The seat is an implementer-side closing checker. It wrote no part of the item. It is not one of the item's authors
(L-0153, L-0162, L-0181, L-0183, L-0189, L-0257, L-0317, L-0373, L-0458) and not this round's author
`build/M0-a-08-fix-s4` (L-0562).

How the seat worked:

* **What it changed.** It changed no file of the item. It wrote this file, rows N-s4c-1 – N-s4c-5 in
  `checks/M0-a-08-notes.md`, its CLEAN-ROOM row, its two landed records and its lane-log lines. It ran no git command.
* **Independence.** It planned its probes and mutants from the brief, the source notes, the inventory rows, the census
  row R-16, C-0376 and the code. It did not open the author's self-check folders or mirror. The author's notes section
  "Hardening round S4" was read only after the seat's own mutant table was written, and only to compare outcomes.
* **The mirror.** `scratchpad/waves/check-M0-a-08/after/plat` is a `tar` copy of the tree's `plat/` without
  `node_modules`, followed by `install --frozen-lockfile`. No symbolic link resolves outside the mirror, and
  `packages/testkit/node_modules/@plat/kernel` resolves inside it.
* **The before-image.** No git and no pre-round copy were available, so the seat rebuilt the pre-round behaviour. It
  took the mirror's sources and undid the round's two behaviour changes: `insetRing`'s refused trial was read as empty
  again (its mutant Z01), and both `traceKept` guards threw again (Z03 + Z04). The result is
  `scratchpad/waves/check-M0-a-08/before/plat`. Every other change in the round is an export, a comment or a test.
* **Process discipline.** One test process ran at a time (`test_budget.py` printed 1, and 1 for `--mutants`). Each
  mutant ran in its own hard-linked copy of the mirror. The mutated file was written to a new inode, and the mirror's
  file was checked by SHA-256 after each run: it was untouched every time.
* **The tree did not move.** At 17:51 the seat took a SHA-256 list of the item's 21 files (the five sources,
  `arr/index.ts`, and both test folders). The mirror matched it. The list was checked again against the tree at the
  end, and `sha256sum -c --quiet` printed nothing.

**The three survivors, judged by the seat** (an author's label never reclassifies a survivor):

* **Z04 is not equivalent, but not a blocker.** `overlayRegion` calls `traceKept` only after `labels.consistent`.
  With consistent labels, the boundary half-edges alternate in and out around every vertex, so every walk closes and
  neither guard can fire (PLAUSIBLE, by reading). The outer guard fires only when `traceKept` is called directly with
  labels no valid overlay gives: a boundary map whose walk enters a cycle that does not hold its first half-edge. The
  row's promise ("E_INVARIANT, never a throw") is held by the code at both guards (CONFIRMED by reading), and the
  pin is red without the fix. The surviving half is a planted-label escape on an unreachable branch. That is a further
  hardening test (N-45, J202), so it is recorded as N-s4c-1.
* **Z05 is equivalent on every input that reaches the line.** By the argument above, `traceKept` never refuses
  under `overlayRegion`. C-0376 (2) states the pass-on, and the code does pass the refusal on (CONFIRMED by reading).
  Recorded as N-s4c-2.
* **Z23 is equivalent on the verdict (PLAUSIBLE).** The final filter (`length ≥ 3`, area ≠ 0) alone already drops a
  ring that rounding collapses: a ring of one or two distinct points, or three with a repeat, has zero area. Any
  difference left by the dedupe is a repeated vertex in a ring with area, which changes neither \|Δ\| nor the face
  count. It is oracle-side test code, and it fails safe. Recorded as N-s4c-3.
